result.summary: The page is generally usable, but the promo banner has a serious contrast/readability problem and a few carousel/card elements are visually clipped or inconsistent.

issues.description: The promotional banner text (“3 free deliveries for you” and the TALLINN3 code line) uses white text on a very pale mint background, making it hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background or switch the text to a dark green/charcoal color to meet WCAG contrast requirements.

issues.description: The rightmost items in horizontal sections are cut off at the screen edge, e.g. “Trattoria Piccol…” and the category chip after “Healthy”, with no clear fade or scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add edge fading, padding, or a visible scroll affordance so clipped content feels intentional and discoverable.

issues.description: Favorite/heart controls are inconsistent: the ramen card uses a light outline heart while the pizza card uses a dark circular filled button.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button style, size, and placement across cards.

issues.description: Restaurant names in the “Fastest near you” carousel are truncated, which can make similarly named places hard to distinguish.
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line titles, reduce card count per viewport, or show full names in a tooltip/expanded state.
